summary: Large-scale removal of GitHub Actions SDLC architecture (38 files deleted, ~15k lines removed) replaced by local pipeline orchestration. New v2 checkpoint system with session-end capture and multi-dimensional indexing is well-implemented. No critical security vulnerabilities introduced by this diff. Pre-existing issues in orchestrator endpoints (webhook auth, input validation) are out of scope for this review cycle. Code quality is high with proper atomic writes, thread safety, and defense-in-depth patterns.
